correctness.rationale: Writing s=(-1)^n, the recurrence gives b=8a+3s and c=16a+5s, so gcd(b,c)=1, gcd(a,b)=gcd(a,3), and 3c=8a+5b. Also 3 divides a exactly when 2^n=(-1)^n mod 9, or 3 divides n. In that branch c belongs to the two-generator semigroup T on a/3,b/3, and its residue shifts by 0,c,2c yield F=3F(T)+2c and g=3g(T)+c-1, also when T=N_0 at n=3. Otherwise an Apéry element can have neither an a summand, nor three c summands, nor a copies of b. In the class kb mod a there are therefore exactly the three candidate forms obtained from y=0,1,2 and the corresponding reduced b coefficient. For t=5/3 mod a and D=c-tb, the candidates differ from kb by yD plus the wrap terms 0,ab, or 2ab. When a=1 mod 3, D<0 and 2D+ab>0, giving the 0,1,2 strips; when a=2 mod 3 and a>=11, D+ab>0 and 2D+ab<0, giving the 0,2,1 strips at u=2t-a and t. Endpoint comparison gives the claimed maxima. In both coprime branches the strip sum differs from a(a-1)b/2 by a(a-5)(8-b)/3, giving the genus. The n=4 redundant c case has F=167 and g=84. Substitution gives both defects and establishes the exact symmetry condition. A separate forward membership computation through a full run of a consecutive representable integers verified F, genus, and the claimed residue minima for n=3,...,11 wherever applicable; it is finite corroboration only.
residual_risks: Only the usual Jacobsthal recurrence and specified offsets for n>=3; no positive-p Frobenius claims.

evidence: The indexed families use (W_i,W_{i+2},W_{i+k}). The wider 2023 family is (a,va+d,va J_{k-1}(v)+d J_k(v)), with positive v,d, k≥3 and gcd(a,d)=1. Matching the ordered first generators forces d=(8-v)a+3s, so 1≤v≤8 and gcd(a,d)=gcd(a,3).
broader_coverage.reasoning: Offset-two indexed coverage cannot match the sorted offsets (0,3,4). Even in the broader family the divisible-by-three branch is outside the coprimality assumption. For a≥43 and k=3 the third generator has a-coefficient 8+8v-v², never 16, and its parity term differs from 5s by at most 22, so it does not equal c. At k=4 the a-coefficient is at least 23 and the parity correction differs by at most 46; the third generator already exceeds c, and grows thereafter because both defining coefficients are positive. Thus this is not a direct specialization for the all-index family.

value.rationale: The offsets retain a short recurrence relation but lie outside the common offset-two triple, a natural nearby family in work on recurrent numerical semigroups. The exact thresholds describe every residue, not just exceptional indices or a finite sample. They determine both principal gap invariants in all indices, identify exactly where the defect vanishes, and provide Apéry data that can be used without running a residue graph search for each index. This is more than applying the known gluing or symmetry criterion to the symmetric branch.
residual_risks: The result does not cover all offsets or positive-p invariants.
